AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord
AuditRecord.description: Hospital waste segregation game audit record tracking pre- and post- game attempt accuracy, scores, and missegregated waste items

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier for the participant

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when the audit round was completed

scenario.description: Clinical department scenario (e.g. Minor Treatment Room, Operating Theatre)

score.description: Total points accumulated in the round

correctCount.description: Count of items placed in correct bins

incorrectCount.description: Count of items placed in wrong bins

timeSpentSeconds.description: Time elapsed during the round in seconds

/audit_records/{recordId}.description: Collection storing hospital waste segregation audit sessions and training attempt records
